# CMMF

> A portable format for content models and the intent behind them.

This website documents CMMF 1.2.0, pinned at 32604441aff09a6dbfe2361e97078af5263fd321. Specifications are normative; site-owned explanations are interpretations. Tool evidence may include development working-tree snapshots and is not a release claim.
